youtube_meta.title: The Cat Who Grew Old With Him
youtube_meta.description:
On a stormy night, a tiny black kitten appears at the door of an old stone cottage.
He brings it inside, warms it by the fire, wraps it in a faded blue-grey blanket, and gives it a home.
Years pass quietly. The kitten grows into a cat. The man grows old. The same chair, the same window, the same blanket, and the same gentle routines stay with them through every season.

And when the chair becomes empty, the old black cat still remembers where home is.

A quiet story about companionship, aging, and the small places where a whole life can live.

🎧 Official song from this story:
Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/track/5bAClGW27dEigIEP229Ab9?si=a7fba3b9e4284967
- Three-Quarter Town

top_comments.text:
I'm 73 and crying now,   with my handsome Blue Russian cat curled up next to me.   He showed up one cold winter at my door last year.
 He's young (maybe 2?) very smart and a great hunter.  He follows me around while I work in my garden...  I've heard they can live up to 20 yrs or more.  That would make me 93.  I hope we both make it........

top_comments.author: @larryrubin1718
top_comments.text: I'm 76 years old ...my wife of almost 60 years passed last year.   I was terribly lonely and spend most of my time in my little apartment.  I adopted an 11 year old cat.  The two of us are old and tired but we bring each other a little comfort. This little video sums up the rest of my life.  If I die before her, I have found a place for her to end her days peacefully.
